title: Removal of sulfides and sulfur recovery from anaerobically treated secondary wastewater using anion exchange
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,2595-2607
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00188A, Paper
Jessica A. MacDonald, Benjamin Najm, William A. Mitch
The sulfides generated during treatment of primary municipal effluent using a staged anaerobic fluidized membrane bioreactor were removed by anion exchange and recovered as elemental sulfur from the brine.
